title: Conditional inductive-cylinder recurrence-to-Cauchy interface
question: If an explicit nonnegative local Q3 recurrence and first/double commutator response estimate hold on the bounded inductive-limit cylinder algebra, what exact finite-volume D/delta-D Cauchy coefficient follows at a fixed boundary distance?

model.cylinder_interface: Use the fixed-support bounded C1 inductive-limit test algebra from EXP-001150; no unbounded polynomial or exact CCR domain is assumed.
model.conditional_recurrence: L_x(n+1) <= (1+C delta)L_x(n) + J delta sum_{y~x} L_y(n), with nonnegative L and graph degree z.
model.weighted_step: The base-weighted norm has one-step factor 1+(C+J z base) delta.
model.spatial_envelope: At boundary distance d, the response envelope is the N-step factor multiplied by base^(-d) and the source mass.
model.cauchy_interface: Under the stated first/double commutator response hypothesis, a two-orientation time-integrated Duhamel difference is bounded by orientation_count*time_horizon*response_envelope.
model.qft_role: This is a conditional bridge from a compatible cylinder algebra to a QFT thermodynamic Cauchy criterion; it does not prove the Q3 recurrence or any state reconstruction.

adversarial_review.check: The recurrence is an explicit hypothesis; the script must not substitute the tested finite Q3 dynamics for this hypothesis.
The one-step factor uses C+J*z*base and the spatial penalty uses base^(-d); no sign or orientation is silently dropped.
The Duhamel coefficient includes both declared orientations and the full time horizon; it is not a pointwise-in-time claim.
The coefficient is conditional on a volume- and cutoff-uniform response hypothesis; the finite fixture itself does not establish that uniformity.
EXP-001150 supplies only bounded fixed-support C1 cylinders, so no unbounded polynomial observable is admitted by this interface.
A conditional Cauchy coefficient is not a common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, mass gap, continuum limit, C6, Sector A or Pre-A result.
R321 proves only exact rational recurrence bookkeeping and the declared scope firewall; it contains no analytic operator or thermodynamic theorem.

lean_crosscheck.role: R321 checks exact rational recurrence and time-integrated coefficient bookkeeping only; it does not formalize the recurrence hypothesis, commutator estimates, dynamics, or limits.

qft_interface.closed: A conditional exact coefficient translating a declared weighted local recurrence and two-orientation response estimate into a bounded cylinder D/delta-D Cauchy envelope at fixed boundary distance.
qft_interface.open: Whether the actual quartic Q3 dynamics satisfies the recurrence, whether first/double commutator response decays uniformly, and all common-alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A gates.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: This package supplies no heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing conditional interface. It computes what the QFT Cauchy estimate would be if the explicit recurrence and response hypotheses were proved; it does not prove those hypotheses.
no_overclaim: The only closed items are exact conditional arithmetic, spatial envelope bookkeeping, and the two-orientation time-integrated coefficient. Actual Q3 dynamics, thermodynamic limits and downstream physical gates remain open.
